prompt: One of the most underrated products in a man’s
response: The shaving routine is a good pre-shave oil. One of the first questions I ask when a gentleman complains of razor burn is whether he uses a pre-shave oil. Of course, there are other factors to a good shave, such as the quality of other shaving products used, razor and other preparation, such as shaving after a shower. Another "trick" to beat irritation is to exfoliate the beard area before shaving with a skin scrub; this will rid the skin of dead skin cells that make it easier for the razor to slide.
